Senate Bill 112 By: Senators Dixon of the 45th, Goodman of the 8th, Anderson of the 24th, Summers of the 13th, Jones II of the 22nd and others
AS PASSED SENATE
A BILL TO BE ENTITLED AN ACT
To amend Chapter 1 of Title 10 of the Official Code of Georgia Annotated, relating to selling and other trade practices, so as to extend certain protections for consumers relative to … of this Act and to any modifications or extensions of such warranties issued, sold, or offered for sale on or after such date.
SECTION 3. All laws and parts of laws in conflict with this Act are repealed.
